sw-domain.name: sw-domain
sw-domain.description: URL of the storefront domain. Used as fallback when `storefrontUrl` is not provided in the request body. Must be one of the configured domains of the sales channel. **Note:** For endpoints that send emails (registration, password recovery, newsletter), either this header OR `storefrontUrl` in the request body is required - at least one must be provided.

sw-include-search-info.name: sw-include-search-info
sw-include-search-info.description: Controls whether API search information is included in the response. Default is 1 (enabled), will be 0 (disabled) in the next major version.
